Camera

Source: R/camera.R, R/zz_constructors.R
CameraClass.Rd

Converts mobjects into frames. CameraClass handles the standard 2D view; MovingCameraClass adds a movable frame and ThreeDCameraClass a 3D projection.

Usage

Camera(
  background_image = NULL,
  frame_center = ORIGIN,
  image_mode = "RGBA",
  n_channels = 4,
  pixel_array_dtype = "uint8",
  cairo_line_width_multiple = 0.01,
  use_z_index = TRUE,
  background = NULL,
  pixel_height = cfg("pixel_height"),
  pixel_width = cfg("pixel_width"),
  frame_height = cfg("frame_height"),
  frame_width = cfg("frame_width"),
  frame_rate = cfg("frame_rate"),
  background_color = cfg("background_color"),
  background_opacity = cfg("background_opacity"),
  ...
)

Arguments

background_image

Path of an image (found with get_full_raster_image_path()) drawn as the background.

frame_center

Point at the center of the frame.

image_mode, n_channels, pixel_array_dtype

Layout of the pixel array (see $get_pixel_array()): "RGBA", 4 channels and "uint8" values, as upstream. pixel_array_dtype sets the largest channel value (rgb_max_val).

cairo_line_width_multiple

Scale of stroke widths, as upstream's.

use_z_index

Draw mobjects in order of their z_index.

background

Accepted as upstream, where the background built from background_image or background_color replaces it.

pixel_width, pixel_height

Size of the frame in pixels.

frame_width, frame_height

Size of the frame in scene units; as upstream, the camera keeps the frame width and derives its height from the pixel aspect ratio.

frame_rate

Frames per second.

background_color, background_opacity

Color and opacity of the background.

...

Ignored.

Value

A Camera, an R6 object. CameraClass is its R6 class generator.
